title: vektor /// no. 047 — Convert files locally, never upload them.
description: The FBI's Denver field office warned in March 2025 that free online file-converter sites were loading malware and scraping uploaded documents. Every one-liner to convert images, PDFs, video, audio and documents on your own machine instead, using ImageMagick, ffmpeg and pandoc, plus the loop Claude Code writes for you when you ask it to batch-convert a folder.
